sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

To move and leap, you'll use the arrow keys or WASD keys, depending on your preference. The left stickman can jump and move, while the right stickman can also jump, but has a slightly different movement pattern.

One of the key mechanics in Stick Bros Leave Prison is the ability to switch between stick figures using a designated key. This allows you to access different areas of the level and overcome obstacles that might be difficult or impossible for one stickman to navigate on their own. By mastering the art of switching between stick figures, you'll be able to progress further in the game and unlock better skins.

As you play through the levels, you'll encounter a variety of obstacles, from treacherous terrain to pesky guards.
